outcome: infant and young child feeding practices
association between feeding practices and mother's age and mode of delivery
cohort: Mothers visiting Chapagaun Primary Health Care and Resource Centre (PHCRC) with child aged 6-23 months between January1-14, 2016
finding: While breastfeeding practices were found to be good, complementary feeding practices among mothers in this Nepalese cohort were poor.
mod_finding: Feeding practices were significantly associated with mode of delivery.
